name: VoxCeleb2
description: A large-scale speaker recognition dataset containing more than one million YouTube audio utterances from over 6,000 speakers, collected from interview videos.
citation: Chung, J. S., Nagrani, A., & Zisserman, A. (2018). VoxCeleb2: Deep Speaker Recognition. Interspeech 2018, 1086–1090. https://doi.org/10.21437/Interspeech.2018-1929
